journeys.job: When a lot arrives with its supplier certificate, confirm every result against our specification so compliant lots are released the same shift and the rest are held with a clear reason.

stages.name: Receive
stages.doing: A lot and its certificate arrive
stages.opportunity: Queue lots with a derived verdict

stages.name: Review
stages.doing: Compare each value with the specification

stages.name: Notify
stages.opportunity: A generated draft, sent by supplier quality

screens.name: Lot queue
screens.purpose: See incoming lots with their derived verdict; find the next lot to review

screens.name: Lot review
screens.purpose: Compare every result with its limit, read the verdict, record the decision

screens.name: Supplier notice draft
screens.purpose: Prepare the supplier notice for a held lot (never sent from here)

screens.name: Decision log
screens.purpose: See every decision, who made it, when, and the verdict at the time

steps.action: Filter to Needs review and open the lot
steps.outcome: The lot review opens with focus on its heading

steps.action: Read results next to limits and the derived verdict
steps.outcome: Ready to release, with the derivation per row

steps.action: Choose Release, add a rationale, record

steps.outcome: The release is the newest entry

flows.name: Hold an out-of-spec lot and draft the notice

steps.action: See the out-of-spec result and the Hold verdict
steps.outcome: Release is locked and says what unlocks it

steps.action: Choose Hold with a rationale of at least 20 characters
Draft the supplier notice and save it
See the missing result and the Escalate verdict
Try a hold with a short rationale
steps.outcome: Refused with a message; focus on the rationale
The queue loads (offline, from the file)

steps.action: Search with no match, then reset
steps.outcome: Empty state with Reset filters; back to all lots

system_behavior: The verdict is derived: any out-of-spec result → Hold; any missing or unreadable result → Escalate (never lower); otherwise Ready
Release is guarded: allowed only when the verdict is Ready
Decisions persist in the browser and appear in the log
Notices are drafts; nothing is ever sent
